persona: Picked by RyAI as Ryan: catches WWE every few weeks, skims the headlines, picks on gut and star power.

notes.mitb_m: Punk's the obvious one, but every clip I see online is Bron spearing someone through something. Feels like his year.
notes.mitb_w: She's won one of these before and she's the only one in there I'd recognise at the airport.
notes.wwc: I didn't know Vaquer was champ until this week. Becky was the ref when the belt changed hands, so you just know she's getting it back.
notes.femi_reed: Everyone calls Oba a monster. Monsters win the opener.
notes.whc: It's Roman. LA Knight's great on the mic but Roman doesn't lose first time out.
notes.cashin: New briefcase winners never cash in the same night. Probably.
notes.bloodline: When has a Roman match ever stayed one-on-one?
notes.main_len: Main events go long. Twenty-something feels right.
